purpose: Additive creative integration: civilization art/design research and music theory/audio production resources and role edges from the five creative agent charters + two packaged skills. No standing roles added; no gaps closed; no evaluation tasks added (lab acceptance tests, not a scored ET battery); all 109 depth scores invariant.

conventions.link_ids: creative edges appended as RL-1684+ by the matrix builder; RL-0001..RL-1683 byte-stable
conventions.task_ids: no creative evaluation tasks; future ones append at the next available ET-{idx}-N suffix
conventions.url_less_references: charter resources without canonical URLs stay charter references (charter_references_not_cataloged)
conventions.depth_invariance: counted edges only where tier attainment is already capped; everything else internal/conditional; all 109 depth scores asserted unchanged

resources.name: Seymour et al. 2023 (Sci Adv eadd1602); Jackson et al. 2017 (Am Min)
resources.purpose: Seymour et al. 2023 pigment/material evidence for dynastic-Egypt color practice (with Jackson et al. 2017)
resources.caveat: Anchored material evidence; not a style claim.

resources.name: Lu & Steinhardt 2007 + Makovicky comment/reply + Cromwell 2015 bias critique
resources.purpose: Lu & Steinhardt girih quasiperiodicity claim, read with the Makovicky 2007 and Cromwell 2015 counterweights attached
resources.caveat: Quasiperiodicity claims ship with both critiques; never as settled.

resources.name: Kaplan & Salesin 2004 (ACM ToG) polygons-in-contact
resources.purpose: Kaplan & Salesin polygons-in-contact construction for Islamic star patterns (modern method, credited)
resources.caveat: Modern construction method; label lab outputs as modern exercises.

resources.name: IIIF Image/Presentation APIs
resources.purpose: IIIF Image/Presentation APIs for interoperable museum image delivery and citation
resources.caveat: Conditional: adopt only when serving digitized collections.

resources.name: isohedral/tactile (BSD-3-Clause) — 93 IH types
resources.purpose: isohedral/tactile: 93 isohedral tiling (IH) types for modern symmetry-classification labs
resources.caveat: Modern scholarship/tooling — never retroject IH notation onto historical makers.

resources.name: Met Open Access (CC0) — object-record citation practice
resources.purpose: Met collection metadata as CC0: object records carry accession number, credit line, and rights fields
resources.caveat: Umbrella CC0 releases do not launder per-item rights; check the rights field per record.

resources.name: Grünbaum 2006 Notices AMS Alhambra challenge + Bodner 2013 census
resources.purpose: Grünbaum's Alhambra symmetry census challenge; contested counts reported as disputes (Müller 11 / Grünbaum–Shephard 13 / Bodner 14 of 17)
resources.caveat: Classification verdicts are criteria-relative; state color handling, extension rule, and census.

resources.name: C2PA content credentials
resources.purpose: C2PA content credentials for signed provenance on creative deliverables
resources.caveat: Conditional: adopt when signed provenance is a deliverable requirement.

resources.name: J. O. Smith CCRMA free DSP texts
resources.purpose: J. O. Smith's free CCRMA DSP texts: filters, spectral processing, physical modeling
resources.caveat: Foundational DSP; pair with the skill's loudness/evaluation standards before claims.

resources.name: Creative Commons license suite discipline (CC0/BY/NC/SA/ND)
resources.license: CC public domain dedication for texts
resources.purpose: Creative Commons license suite discipline (CC0/BY/NC/SA/ND) for creative deliverables
resources.caveat: A license is a grant with conditions; NC/SA/ND terms bind downstream use.

resources.name: Web Audio API spec (W3C) + AudioWorklet
resources.purpose: Web Audio API specification including AudioWorklet for browser synthesis/processing
resources.caveat: Spec, not implementation guidance; check current browser behavior.

resources.name: music21 (BSD-3) for computational verification of analytical claims
resources.purpose: music21 for computational verification of analytical claims (corpus, harmony, counterpoint tooling)
resources.caveat: Verification aid, not evidence by itself; cite the underlying sources.

resources.name: Bridgeport 410 F.3d 792 (6th Cir. 2005) vs VMG Salsoul 824 F.3d 871 (9th Cir. 2016) — unresolved split
resources.purpose: Bridgeport 410 F.3d 792 (6th Cir. 2005) vs VMG Salsoul 824 F.3d 871 (9th Cir. 2016): the sampling circuit split
resources.caveat: Unsettled law — report the split, never declare sampling categorically legal or illegal.

resources.name: MIDI 1.0/2.0 + MPE (midi.org)
resources.purpose: MIDI 1.0/2.0 and MPE specifications for note/control interchange
resources.caveat: Use current adopted versions; MPE support varies by device/host.

resources.name: ITU-R BS.1770-5 + EBU R128 loudness delivery
resources.purpose: EBU R128 / ITU-R BS.1770-5 loudness normalization for delivery
resources.caveat: Only tools implementing BS.1770 may make LUFS claims; RMS/peak metrics are not LUFS.

resources.name: Open Music Theory (CC BY-SA, Vanderbilt)
resources.purpose: Open Music Theory (Vanderbilt): dated Western common-practice theory reference
resources.caveat: One documented tradition, not the physics of music; label conventions as conventions.

resources.name: Tennessee ELVIS Act 2024 (Pub. Ch. 588)
resources.purpose: Voice/likeness protection statute for AI-era persona uses
resources.caveat: One jurisdiction; other states differ — name jurisdiction on every persona claim.

resources.name: US Copyright Office AI reports (Part 2 Copyrightability Jan 2025; Part 3 training pre-pub 2025); Thaler v. Perlmutter (D.C. Cir. 2025)
resources.purpose: US Copyright Office AI reports (Part 2 Copyrightability Jan 2025; Part 3 training) as the registrability baseline
resources.caveat: Office reports are guidance, not binding law; AI-training litigation is unresolved.

resources.name: US two-copyrights model (17 U.S.C. §§102/106/114); MMA 2018 + MLC
resources.purpose: US two-copyrights model (17 U.S.C. §§102/106/114), MMA 2018, and the Mechanical Licensing Collective
resources.caveat: US-centric baseline; always name jurisdiction; not legal advice.
